name: Commercial International Bank Egypt (CIB) S.A.E.
source: Yahoo Finance | extended from stockanalysis.com | H1 2026 and H1 2025 columns added 2026-11-22 from Commercial International Bank (Egypt) S.A.E. condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026, released to the London Stock Exchange as RNS 1119N on 21 July 2026, EGP thousands scaled to EGP. Revenue is the printed net operating income 65,587,000 (net interest income 60,826,148 plus non-interest income 4,761,000 as printed in the earnings release). Operating expenses are the printed administrative expenses 10,356,040. Net finance costs are interest and similar expense 49,741,855. PBT 54,159,044 less income tax 14,495,340 and the deferred tax charge 349,978, i.e. 14,845,318, equals the printed net profit 39,313,726 exactly. EPS 10.23 is the printed basic earnings per share (diluted 10.11). H1 2025 from the same statement: net operating income 54,870,000, administrative expenses 7,916,000, interest expense 53,825,527, PBT 46,259,692, income tax 12,913,056 after adding back the 549,173 deferred tax credit, net profit 33,346,636 and EPS 8.82, all tying to the printed statement. The H1 2026 ROE, ROA and debt to equity are period ratios on the 30 June 2026 balance stored in the balance file; the H1 2025 ratios are left empty because the release prints no balance sheet as at 30 June 2025.
periods_note: columns dropped: FY2021 - no row in this file carries a figure for them, so they rendered as pure dashes
note: Periods and blank series extended from stockanalysis.com (secondary provider, reported figures). A value was accepted only where the provider reproduced the stored figure for the same row in an overlapping year within 1.5 percent; no existing value was changed.
